ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro contrast between dominant low-intensity black pigmentation and sparse high-intensity white markings. White pixel distribution is approximately <10% of total visible fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Black (low intensity) base across both lobes. Discrete white (high intensity) clusters of 1-5 pixel diameter scattered across the central surface. High-density contiguous white cluster located at the right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 50 degrees, bifurcating the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right trailing edge exhibits irregular serrations with visible peaks and valleys. The left trailing edge is significantly occluded by foreground avian subjects, preventing full extraction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges towards the median notch; convex leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white clusters distributed across the ventral surface, primarily on the right lobe and center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity white scarring and irregular tissue growth located at the right lateral fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the fluke surface by multiple avian subjects (birds) in the foreground, creating motion-blurred pixel clusters across the field of view.
